snippet.title: Antidote - Vaccine Defense Trailer
snippet.description:
The new Antidote is here with fully updated vaccine game play, new diseases, and new levels!
Download Antidote at https://antidote.app.link/trailer_yt

- Build your maze and upgrade your defenses
- Eat and beat the bacteria
- Gather research points by defeating enemies
- Develop new vaccines and use them for different strategies and different levels of difficulty
- Learn about cells, bacteria, viruses and vaccines
- Challenge yourself for higher scores
